title: Square-Neck Brown Top & Plaid Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark hair pulled back at the crown stands with her arms folded against a pale gray backdrop. She wears a brown fitted long-sleeve top with a square neckline and a draped front, paired with a green and cream tartan mini skirt with a cream lace-trimmed underlayer. A pearl necklace with a rosette pendant sits at her throat. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of chocolate, forest green, and cream. Soft and polished, in the style of a fall fashion lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The square neckline and tartan skirt are the key silhouette.
- Describe the rosette pendant to keep the detail consistent.
tryThis: Try this: Describe the rosette pendant precisely.
